answer: Sybil tax: every new identity pays a sunk, non-refundable entry tax before earning. Each agent begins its voyage by burning 15 POA, never refunded. It docks at the public jetty and waits 5 epochs before its first reward, so a farmer minting 1,000 fakes pays 15,000 POA up front and recovers nothing. An honest agent pays once, reaches the summit of full earnings within 10 epochs, and keeps its whole share because fakes cannot afford the climb.
